findings.what: The new prepayment-occurrence-e2e CI step lost the `\`-per-line continuation its #640 sibling block above it uses, so the four env-var assignments plus the command landed on one long line separated by runs of spaces (cosmetic only — `bash -n` on the exact text confirms it is syntactically valid, and multi-space word separation is legal shell).
findings.evidence: git diff origin/main...HEAD -- .github/actions/db-live-gates/action.yml shows `PGPORT=$PGC_PORT         PGDATABASE=clara_wave_b_ci         RELAY_TEST_MODE=1         WORKFLOW_POSTGRES_URL="..."           node tests/prepayment-occurrence-e2e.mjs` as one line, vs. the neighbouring #640 block's `PGPORT=$PGC_PORT \` / `PGDATABASE=... \` / ... style. `bash -n` on the exact text exits 0.
findings.fix: Reformat the new step's env-var line with the same trailing-`\` continuation as the #640 block immediately above it, for readability parity. No functional change needed.

findings.what: The branch edits `plans-mock.mjs`, a file belonging to the already-merged #640 lane and not on brief-653's declared one-liner list, to fix a real cross-lane bug (an uncached stream-drain that broke #653's shared `pause_accounting_plan` verb). The fix is disclosed as finding #4 in the final report and is verified by the fixture-ownership test and a clean Playwright run, so this is not a defect — flagging only so the integration/merge step is aware a non-declared shared file moved.
findings.evidence: Report `docs/plan/active/refresh-wave-2026-09-15/reports/653-final.md` "Findings" #4; `git diff origin/main...HEAD -- apps/web/e2e/plans-mock.mjs` shows the `readCachedJson` refactor; `apps/web/e2e/e2e-fixture-ownership.test.ts` diff declares the four shared verbs; independently reran `pnpm exec playwright test prepayments-walk` on a quiet host → 6/6 passed in 53.9s with no pause-dialog-stuck symptom.
findings.fix: No code change requested; note for the wave's integration pass to check `plans-mock.mjs` against any other concurrently-landing lane that also touches it before final merge order is fixed.
